args: Weekly antigravity-3d failure-to-skill distillation. Run `uv run python -m antigravity3d.runtime.distill_job` in the workspace and read the printed proposal. Report eligible rule IDs with their held-out metrics and evidence digests for human review. If a candidate is withheld, report the missing evidence or regression. Never enable a rule or draft a skill change from an unvalidated cluster.
description: Summarizes observed fixes and held-out replay every Sunday at 03:43 UTC. Promotion requires explicit review.
